title: Library and Learning Resource Center | Lemoore College
content: The Library and Learning Resource Center is located at 555 College Avenue, Building 400, and operates Monday - Thursday 8am - 7pm, Friday 8am - 4pm. Contact: (559) 925-3420 and ask@westhillscollege.libanswers.com. The center offers a searchable collection of Books, eBooks, eJournals and Videos through its OneSearch interface. Users can access My Library Account for personal resources. The facility provides several support options including Databases, Research & Citation Guides, Study Rooms available for booking, and Tutoring services. A Magazine Collection is available digitally, and the center maintains instructional videos covering topics like Introduction to College Research, Finding eBooks, Finding Print Books, and Accessing Databases.
